name: cleanup-close
question: The cleanup of .cache/v0512 at v0.5.12's close (#218 comment 7202383280, item 6): archive what has value to the Drive with a checked SHA-256 manifest, delete it, and delete the regenerable copies (cpy, git, cvenv), by literal path inside .cache/v0512.
choices: docs/maintenance/cleanup-2026-11-26-v0512-close/cleanup.py, committed before the run; a new unit file (rule (c)). Through launch_v4 (outside the AppContainer, in the launcher's job object). Writes outside the project only to the Drive archive folder; record.json beside the script. A data unit: the arguments make the unit.
